    About the Product

    SENSI SMART3 features three skin-hugging blades that minimize the risk of nicks and cuts while delivering an exceptionally gentle shaving experience. Its innovative triple-action lubricating strip is enriched with nourishing Aloe Vera, premium Moroccan Argan oil, and vitamin E that actively heals and refreshes your skin throughout the shaving process.

    The advanced pivot head intelligently adjusts to follow every contour of your face, providing complete control and safety as it glides seamlessly over each curve with maximum precision. Despite offering best-in-class performance and consistently smooth shaves, the SENSI SMART3 maintains a super competitive price point that delivers unbeatable value, making premium shaving accessible without compromising on quality or results.

    How to use
    • Keep the razor in water for about 3-5 seconds to activate the lubricating strip.
    • Apply shaving cream or foam on damp skin.
    • Glide the razor gently on your face in the direction of hair growth.
    • Rinse the razor after each swipe.
    • Store your razor in a dry place
